label: DAY 31
title: My Saturday Short got 399 views in 6 hours. This Saturday's got 4.

lines.text: Your big hit aired on a Saturday. Post on weekends!
So I tested it. Day thirty aired this Saturday.
Four? Same day, same cartoon look?
Same day. Same look. About a hundred times fewer.
Okay, so maybe Sunday is the magic day?
One Sunday got one seventy six. One isn't a pattern.
And a Thursday beat this Saturday, twenty to four.

scenes.title: What I blamed for my one hit

lines.text: So what actually makes a Short blow up?
First I blamed the cartoon look. Then weekends.
Each one got a single hit, then a flop.

scenes.text: This Short airs on a Sunday
